verdict.rationale: Token2 sells FIDO2 security keys, and its tooling supports SSH security keys generated on the key and added to ssh-agent, plus WebAuthn registration and login. These are the building blocks for gating sensitive actions behind a physical key, but the evidence never documents touch or user-presence enforcement, nor any way to use it as an approval step for automated or agent-initiated actions. missing for 10: explicit documentation of touch/user-presence requirements, any integration or guidance for gating agent or automation actions, configurable per-action approval policies, independent or hands-on corroboration.
